articles.title: Serve Markdown to AI Agents with Accept Headers

articles.summary: 如果你正在给AI Agent适配网页内容，用HTTP内容协商直接返回Markdown，比维护爬虫和API更轻量标准
articles.body:
Serve Markdown to AI agents with content negotiation

Your site already has the content. Serving a Markdown variant lets agent AI clients skip nav/scripts/layout markup and read the content directly.

Share on X (opens in new tab) Share on LinkedIn (opens in new tab) Share on Bluesky (opens in new tab) Share on Reddit (opens in new tab) Share on Mastodon (opens in new tab) Other… Copy link

A fraction of the bytes.

Markdown drops nav, styles, scripts, and layout wrappers. Agents spend context on your prose, not your DOM.

Higher signal-to-noise.

No ads, related-content rails, or modal overlays muddying the text a RAG pipeline has to embed.

Less to fetch, less to parse, less to stuff into the context window before the model starts thinking.

Download scorecard image Copy scorecard image Other…
articles.bodyZh:
用内容协商为 AI 代理提供 Markdown 版本

你的网站本来就有内容。提供 Markdown 版本，能让 AI 代理（AI agents）客户端跳过导航、脚本和布局标记，直接读内容。

分享到 X（在新标签页打开） 分享到 LinkedIn（在新标签页打开） 分享到 Bluesky（在新标签页打开） 分享到 Reddit（在新标签页打开） 分享到 Mastodon（在新标签页打开） 其他… 复制链接

字节数只有一小部分。

Markdown 去掉了导航、样式、脚本和布局包装。代理把上下文花在你的文章上，而不是你的 DOM（文档对象模型）上。

信噪比更高。

没有广告、相关内容推荐栏或弹窗来污染需要 RAG（检索增强生成）管道嵌入的文本。

要抓取的内容更少，解析的内容更少，在模型开始思考之前要塞进上下文窗口的东西也更少。

下载记分卡图片 复制记分卡图片 其他…

articles.title: Launch HN: Risklytics (YC S26) – Insurance brokerage for frontier tech companies
articles.zh: 发布HN：Risklytics（YC S26）——面向前沿科技公司的保险经纪服务
articles.summary: 如果你在AI、航天等前沿领域创业，这家YC新公司专门收拾传统保险不接的高风险单子，值得留意
articles.body:
Insurance for the Frontier Commercial insurance for companies putting AI to work, from software teams to robot fleets. Coverage built around how you actually operate, placed with carriers that want this risk.

An AI agent handling customer work, or a robot on a customer site, carries risk that standard commercial forms never contemplated. Carriers quote it anyway, on paper drafted before any of this existed, and the exclusions buried in that paper surface after a loss.

Risklytics is a brokerage built for companies that put AI to work, from models in a workflow to machines in the field. We take the operation to carriers that want this risk on their books, and we read every form that comes back before anything binds.

You describe the business once. We handle the insurance translation.

Answer three short questions about what you build and where it touches the physical world. Plain English is the point.

AI turns your words into a draft application. You review and confirm every field before it goes anywhere.

Your submission goes to carriers that want this risk. Submissions are reviewed by a licensed producer; nothing is bound online.

You choose the lines inside the application. The packages below are ready-made combinations of these.

Injuries and third-party property damage. Professional Liability (Tech E&O) Your tech failing and costing a customer money. Cyber Liability Hacks, breaches and stolen data. Directors & Officers Leadership decisions and investor suits. Commercial Property Your buildings, offices and contents. Equipment (Inland Marine) Robots and rigs, in transit and on site. Workers' Compensation Your team, injured on the job. Extra Limits (Umbrella) Extra limits for demanding contracts. Packages

Pick the closest match. You can change every requested coverage line before the application goes to broker review.

For teams shipping a first product or running a limited pilot.

General Liability D&O Tech E&O Cyber Deployed Systems For AI and machines working in production at customer sites.

D&O Tech E&O General Liability Equipment Cyber Fleet Operations Higher limits as revenue, headcount, and deployments grow.

D&O Tech E&O General Liability Equipment Workers' Comp Cyber Umbrella These are application starting points, not evidence of coverage. Carrier appetite, policy terms, licensing, and availability govern every quote.
articles.bodyZh:
做前沿业务的商业保险。不管是软件团队还是机器人车队，只要是把AI投入实际应用的公司，我们都能承保。我们的保障方案完全按照你的实际运营方式来设计，而且只跟真正愿意接这类风险的保险公司合作。

一个AI客服在处理客户事务，或者一台机器人在客户现场作业——这类风险，传统的标准保单根本就没想过要覆盖。但保险公司照样给你报价，用的还是这些东西出现之前就拟好的老合同。等真出了事故，埋在小字里的免责条款就浮出水面了。

Risklytics是一家专为“把AI投入实际应用”的公司打造的保险经纪机构。不管是嵌在工作流程里的模型，还是跑到现场干活的机器，我们都会把你的业务情况带给那些愿意把这风险记在自己账上的保险公司。而且，在保单最终生效之前，我们拿到每一份文件都会逐字逐句读完。

你只需要把业务讲一遍，剩下的保险“翻译”工作交给我们。

回答三个简单的小问题，说说你在做什么产品、它怎么跟物理世界产生联系。用大白话就行。

AI会把你的回答整理成一份投保申请草稿。每一栏你都要自己过目确认，然后才会提交出去。

提交后，申请会送到愿意承接这类风险的保险公司手中。所有申请都由持牌保险经纪人审核，全程不会在线上直接绑保。

你可以在申请里自己勾选需要的险种。下面这些套餐就是这些险种的现成组合。

人身伤害和第三方财产损失。
职业责任险（科技类错误与疏漏，Tech E&O）——你的技术出bug，导致客户损失钱。
网络安全责任险——黑客攻击、数据泄露、信息被盗。
董事及高管责任险——管理层决策失误、被投资人告。
商业财产险——你的办公楼、办公室和里面的东西。
设备险（内陆水运险，Inland Marine）——机器人和其他设备，不管在运输途中还是现场作业都保。
工伤赔偿险——你的员工在上班时受伤。
超额责任险（伞式保险，Umbrella）——应对合同里要求的高额保障。
套餐

挑一个最接近你情况的。在申请单送到经纪人手里之前，所有险种你都可以随时改。

适合正在推首个产品、或者做小范围试点的团队。

一般责任险

科技类错误与疏漏险
网络安全险
已部署系统

适合AI和机器人在客户现场投入正式生产的场景。

董事及高管责任险
科技类错误与疏漏险
一般责任险
设备险

一般责任险
设备险

articles.title: VBVR-Pro: A Scalable and Verifiable Suite for Native Visual Reasoning
articles.zh: VBVR-Pro: A Scalable and Verifiable Suite for Native Visual Reasoning
articles.author: Junxiang Xu, Ruisi Wang 等
articles.body: Native visual reasoning treats visual generation as the medium of reasoning itself: visual states (i.e. images and videos) are not merely inputs to be understood or outputs to be rendered, but first-class substrates for problem solving beyond language. Yet progress remains bottlenecked by the lack of scalable training tasks, reliable feedback, and controlled comparisons across generative substrates. In this work, we introduce VBVR-Pro, a closed-loop testbed that makes native visual reasoning through generation trainable, verifiable, optimizable, and experimentally controllable. 1) Task scaling. VBVR-Pro turns visual reasoning into a controlled task space of 300 procedurally generated tasks. Models trained on VBVR-Pro show strong transfer beyond the proposed suite across seven external visual reasoning benchmarks such as RISE-Video, MME-CoF-Pro, and BabyVision. 2) Verifiable rewards. VBVR-Pro provides verifiable reward scorers for task-grounded evaluation. Through a systematic study of leading MLLMs as judges, we identify recurring failure modes of the prevalent VLM-as-a-judge paradigm. In contrast, the proposed scorers are grounded in deterministic, task-specific rules, achieve fine-grained alignment with human judgments. Importantly, they serve as reliable reward signals for large-scale multi-task reinforcement learning and demonstrate stronger post-RL performance across visual reasoning tasks. 3) Mechanism study. VBVR-Pro enables controlled modality studies across more than 30 image, video, and interleaved generators. Our analysis shows that video generation remains strongest for tasks requiring persistent spatiotemporal state tracking, while interleaved generation provides a compute-efficient alternative. Critically, ablations and probing suggest the presence of vision-native trajectories that are crucial to visual reasoning. We release all data, models, scorers, and code.
articles.bodyZh:
原生视觉推理（native visual reasoning）的核心思路是：把“生成图像或视频”这件事本身当作推理的过程。也就是说，视觉状态——也就是图像和视频——不只是用来“看懂”的输入，也不只是最后渲染出来的结果，它们是比语言更直接、更底层的一等公民，专门用来解决那些靠说话绕来绕去也说不清的问题。但这条路现在一直卡在几个地方：缺少能大规模训练的任务、缺少可靠的反馈信号、以及不同类型生成器之间没法做公平对照。为了解决这些问题，我们推出了VBVR-Pro，这是一个闭环测试平台（closed-loop testbed），让“通过生成来做原生视觉推理”这件事变得可训练、可验证、可调优，而且还能做严格的实验对照。

第一点是任务规模化。VBVR-Pro把视觉推理变成了一块受控的任务场，里面有300个程序化自动生成的任务。用这块任务场训练的模型，不只是在这300个任务上表现好，还能显著迁移到外面七个视觉推理基准测试上，比如RISE-Video、MME-CoF-Pro、BabyVision这些，说明学到的能力是通用而不是死记硬背。

第二点是可验证的奖励机制。VBVR-Pro为每个任务都配了可验证的奖励评分器（verifiable reward scorers），用来做任务级别的评估。我们系统性研究了目前主流的“让多模态大模型当裁判”的做法，发现VLM-as-a-judge这套范式有很常见的翻车模式。相比之下，我们的评分器基于确定性的、针对具体任务的规则，结果和人的判断可以做到非常精细的对齐。更重要的是，这套评分器可以当作稳定的奖励信号，用在大规模多任务强化学习（reinforcement learning）上。实验结果显示，用我们的奖励做强化学习之后，模型在各类视觉推理任务上的表现都更强。

第三点是机制研究。VBVR-Pro支持做跨模态的受控对照实验，覆盖30多种图像生成器、视频生成器和交错生成器（interleaved generators）。我们的分析发现，对于那些需要对空间和时间状态持续追踪的任务，视频生成仍然是最强的选择；而交错生成则提供了一个计算成本更低的替代方案。最关键的是，通过消融实验和探测分析，我们发现了“视觉原生轨迹”（vision-native trajectories）的存在，这种轨迹对视觉推理来说至关重要。我们现在已经把全部数据、模型、评分器和代码都开源了。

articles.title: A Visual Dependence-Aware Framework for Multimodal Unsupervised Continual Post-Training
articles.zh: A Visual Dependence-Aware Framework for Multimodal Unsupervised Continual Post-Training
articles.author: Kaichen Li, Zhilin Zhu 等
articles.body: In this paper, we explore a novel task of Multimodal Unsupervised Continual Post-Training (MU-CPT), enabling deployed MLLMs to continually evolve from streaming unlabeled data. Existing unsupervised post-training methods for MLLMs typically optimize target tokens uniformly, overlooking their heterogeneous visual dependence (VD). However, we reveal that token-level VD is crucial for MU-CPT. Specifically, its structural distortion serves as an indicator of cross-modal catastrophic forgetting, and its inherent heterogeneity acts as a compass to guide new-task learning. Leveraging this property, we propose a Visual Dependence-Aware (VDA) framework with two main components. First, Visually Constrained Optimal Transport (VC-OT) formulates the VD structural distortion of old-task VD during new-task learning as an optimal transport problem to mitigate cross-modal forgetting. By designing a region-aware ground cost and a dependence-stratified transport penalty, it prevents global shifts in visual focus while strictly prohibiting visual reliance from degenerating into language bias. Second, Visually Modulated Adaptation (VMA) exploits VD heterogeneity to emphasize visually grounded new-task learning, promoting new-task plasticity. Together, our method simultaneously maintains old-task stability and new-task plasticity during challenging MU-CPT. Extensive experiments under our MU-CPT setting validate the effectiveness of VDA.
articles.bodyZh: 在这篇论文里，我们研究了一个新任务：多模态无监督持续后训练（MU-CPT）。简单说，就是让已经部署好的多模态大模型（MLLM），能不断从源源不断的无标签数据里继续学习、进化。现有的多模态无监督后训练方法，通常都是均匀地去优化所有目标词元，没有注意到它们对视觉信息的依赖程度其实是不同的。但我们发现，这种词元级别的视觉依赖（VD）恰恰是MU-CPT的关键。具体来说，视觉依赖的结构发生扭曲，可以作为跨模态灾难性遗忘的一个信号；而它本身的不均匀性，又能像指南针一样，引导模型去学习新任务。基于这个特性，我们提出了一个“视觉依赖感知”（VDA）框架，主要包含两个部分。第一部分是“视觉约束最优传输”（VC-OT），它把学习新任务时旧任务视觉依赖的结构扭曲，建模成一个最优传输问题，用来缓解跨模态遗忘。我们设计了一种区域感知的地面代价函数，加上一个按依赖程度分层的传输惩罚项，这样既能防止模型的视觉焦点整体跑偏，又能严格避免视觉依赖退化成语义偏见。第二部分是“视觉调制适配”（VMA），它利用视觉依赖的不均匀性，重点强化那些真正基于视觉的新任务学习，提升模型在新任务上的可塑性。两者结合起来，我们这个方法就能在充满挑战的MU-CPT场景下，同时兼顾旧任务的稳定性和新任务的可塑性。我们在自己设定的MU-CPT设置下做了大量实验，结果验证了VDA框架的有效性。

articles.title: MyoMechanix: Biomechanically-Grounded Compositional Skilled Activity Understanding and Coaching
articles.zh: MyoMechanix: Biomechanically-Grounded Compositional Skilled Activity Understanding and Coaching
articles.author: Hao Yin, Paritosh Parmar 等
articles.body: Existing action quality assessment (AQA) datasets and methods rely primarily on visual inputs such as RGB and pose, overlooking physiological dynamics such as muscle mechanics and often modeling actions as monolithic patterns. These limitations hinder fine-grained, biomechanically grounded feedback. We introduce MyoMechanix, a multimodal ecosystem for weight-loaded actions that aligns motion with muscle activity. Expert-annotated, it contains 7,500+ samples of 20 actions from 38 subjects, with synchronized multiview RGB video, 3D pose, sEMG, and additional physiological signals, forming the largest multimodal AQA benchmark to date. We further construct the Fitness Knowledge Graph (FKG), which organizes expert annotations into structured relationships among actions, phases, key steps, errors, and corrective feedback, enabling compositional scoring and interpretable assessment. Building on these representations, we develop CUBIST (Compositional Ontological Reasoning Engine), which performs decomposition-analysis-recomposition for fine-grained error attribution and feedback generation. We also establish MyoMechanix-AQA, MyoMechanix-VideoQA, and a novel MyoMechanix-Video2EMG task. Experiments show that multimodal sensing and structured representations improve performance, interpretability, and error attribution, with CUBIST achieving state-of-the-art results; VideoQA enhances language-grounded action understanding; and Video2EMG suggests video-based alternatives to costly EMG sensing. MyoMechanix advances skilled activity understanding toward biomechanically grounded, multimodal, and compositional reasoning for Physical AI applications in fitness, rehabilitation, healthcare, and machine learning. Project page: https://haoyin116.github.io/MyoMechanix/
articles.bodyZh:
现有动作质量评估（AQA）的数据集和方法，基本都靠视觉信息，比如RGB视频和姿态数据，完全忽略了肌肉力学这类生理动态，而且常常把动作当成一个整体模板来建模。这么一来，就没法给出精细的、基于生物力学的反馈。所以我们推出了MyoMechanix，一个专门针对负重动作的多模态生态系统，能把动作和肌肉活动对齐起来。它由专家标注，包含38位受试者、20种动作的7500多个样本，带有同步的多视角RGB视频、3D姿态、表面肌电（sEMG）以及其他生理信号，是目前规模最大的多模态AQA基准。

在此基础上，我们还构建了健身知识图谱（FKG），把专家标注整理成动作、阶段、关键步骤、错误和纠正反馈之间的结构化关系，这样就能支持组合式评分和可解释的评估。接着，我们开发了CUBIST（组合式本体推理引擎），它通过“分解—分析—重组”来做细粒度的错误归因和反馈生成。同时，我们还建立了MyoMechanix-AQA、MyoMechanix-VideoQA，以及一个全新的MyoMechanix-Video2EMG任务。

实验结果显示，多模态感知和结构化表示能明显提升性能、可解释性和错误归因能力，其中CUBIST达到了当前最优水平；VideoQA增强了基于语言的动作理解；而Video2EMG则说明，可以用视频来代替成本高昂的肌电传感。总之，MyoMechanix把专业技能理解推向了一个更生物力学、更贴合多模态和组合式推理的新高度，特别适合健身、康复、医疗和机器学习这些Physical AI应用场景。项目主页在这里：https://haoyin116.github.io/MyoMechanix/

articles.title: PlanSightRAG: A Visual-First Multimodal RAG for Automating Question Answering and Compliance Checking for Civil Standard Plans
articles.zh: PlanSightRAG: A Visual-First Multimodal RAG for Automating Question Answering and Compliance Checking for Civil Standard Plans
articles.author: Nabaraj Subedi, Shuvo Dip Datta 等
articles.body: Civil infrastructure compliance checking has long relied on engineers manually reading legacy 2D plans; however, OCR-based automation strips away the geometry and layout essential for interpreting these plans. We present a Visual-First Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework called PlanSightRAG. It indexes and reasons directly over plan imagery, integrates a ColNomic-3B multi-vector retrieval, an agentic Planner-Retriever-Auditor-Synthesizer, and MaxSim heatmaps as an evidence trail. We introduce a 4,056-pair benchmark from five state Departments of Transportation (DOT) standard plans (1,898 pages). PlanSightRAG achieves 91.47% Recall@5 on zero-shot retrieval, while on a held-out Michigan DOT corpus, it achieves 91.40%. On synthetic, parametrically-generated compliance drawings, our Qwen2.5-VL-72B pipeline reaches 100% verdict accuracy only when supplied a pre-resolved rule threshold, a controlled ceiling that a non-VLM OCR baseline already reaches at 76.4%. Finally, we demonstrate autonomous visual rule-grounding by extracting numeric limits directly from a specification corpus without any human-supplied rules.
articles.bodyZh:
长期以来，土木基础设施的合规审查都靠工程师们埋头翻阅老旧的2D图纸，一项一项地人工比对。虽然现在有了基于OCR的自动化工具，但问题是，这种工具会把图纸里最关键的几何信息和版面布局全给丢掉了，而这些恰恰是理解图纸的核心要素。为此，我们提出了一套“视觉优先”的多模态检索增强生成框架（Retrieval-Augmented Generation，RAG），名字叫PlanSightRAG。它的思路是直接对图纸图像本身进行索引和推理，不再依赖文字转换。具体来说，这套框架整合了ColNomic-3B多向量检索（multi-vector retrieval），加上一个由规划、检索、审核、合成四个角色组成的智能体流程（Planner-Retriever-Auditor-Synthesizer），并用MaxSim热力图作为证据追踪路径，让每一步都透明可查。

为了验证效果，我们从五个州的交通部（Department of Transportation，DOT）标准图纸中整理出一个包含4,056对问答的基准测试集，共涉及1,898页图纸。结果显示，PlanSightRAG在零样本检索（zero-shot retrieval）场景下达到了91.47%的召回率（Recall@5）；在密歇根州交通部的一个独立语料上，也稳稳拿到了91.40%的召回率。而在我们合成生成的参数化合规图纸上，基于Qwen2.5-VL-72B的完整推理流程，只有在预先设定好规则阈值的情况下，才能达到100%的判断准确率——这个受控的上限，对照实验显示，传统的非视觉语言模型（non-VLM）OCR基线只能做到76.4%。更进一步，我们还展示了这套系统可以不依赖任何人预先给定的规则，直接从规范文档里自主提取数字限制，实现真正的视觉化规则落地。

articles.title: Finding and using interpretable latents in a neutrino foundation model with sparse autoencoders
articles.zh: Finding and using interpretable latents in a neutrino foundation model with sparse autoencoders
articles.author: Raphaël Bonnet-Guerrini, Johann Ioannou-Nikolaides 等
articles.body: We present a first application of sparse-autoencoder-based mechanistic interpretability to particle physics. Studying a neutrino foundation model pretrained on IceCube data and fine-tuned for direction reconstruction, we identify a validated atlas of physical concepts in the model representation, using a strict validation protocol consisting of held-out tests, matched nuisance controls, and replication across independent dictionary trainings. Causal interventions show that the direction head barely draws on this atlas. Motivated by this underused information, we train an uncertainty head on the same event-level representation to predict the model's angular reconstruction error. Unlike the direction head, it depends causally on quality and brightness features from the atlas. At $20\%$ selection efficiency, this interpretable estimator improves the median angular resolution from $20.2^\circ$ to $3.2^\circ$. These results suggest that mechanistic interpretability can reveal learned latent physics encoded within a model's internal representation and help design downstream tasks that exploit it.
articles.bodyZh: 我们这次把一种叫“稀疏自编码器”（sparse autoencoder）的机械可解释性（mechanistic interpretability）方法，头一回用在了粒子物理上。我们研究了一个中微子基础模型——它先是在冰立方（IceCube）数据上预训练，然后又专门针对方向重建任务做了微调。通过一套非常严格的验证流程，包括留出测试、匹配干扰对照，还有跨独立字典训练的重复验证，我们在模型的内部表示里整理出了一套经过验证的“物理概念图谱”（atlas）。因果干预实验表明，模型里负责方向预测的那个“方向头”（direction head）几乎没怎么用到这套图谱。看到这个信息被浪费，我们就在同一个事件级表示上又训练了一个“不确定性头”（uncertainty head），专门用来预测模型在角度重建上的误差。跟方向头不一样的是，这个不确定性头在因果层面确实依赖图谱里的质量和亮度特征。在20%选择效率下，这个可解释的估计器把中位角分辨率从20.2°直接拉到了3.2°。这些结果说明，机械可解释性能够把模型内部学到的潜在物理规律挖出来，还能帮我们设计下游任务，把这些规律真正用起来。

articles.title: Planetary Prediction Engine: Autonomous Geospatial Prediction via Intelligent Data Selection and Foundation Model Embeddings
articles.zh: Planetary Prediction Engine: Autonomous Geospatial Prediction via Intelligent Data Selection and Foundation Model Embeddings
articles.author: Evelyn Ma, Rama Kumar Pasumarthi 等
articles.body: Addressing critical global challenges, from food security and disaster risk to disease outbreaks and socio-economic vulnerability, demands high-fidelity geospatial modeling. However, building predictive planetary models remains bottlenecked by a fragmented data ecosystem, requiring manual data retrieval, multimodal data curation and fusion along with iterative model selection. We present the Planetary Prediction Engine (PPE), an autonomous AI system that executes this end-to-end workflow directly from natural-language queries. PPE synthesizes multimodal datasets on the fly, retrieving spatiotemporally relevant covariates across open-web and Earth observation platforms (Data Commons, Google Earth Engine) and fusing them with geospatial foundation model embeddings (PDFM, AlphaEarth). Simultaneously, it searches over task-tailored model architecture families with automated overfitting guards. Across diverse tasks, geographies, and scientific domains, PPE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art or manually tuned expert baselines. For US spatial regression, PPE improves mean $R^2$ across 21 CDC health indicators (76.8% vs. 60.0%), FEMA national risk indices (64.9% vs. 60.0%), and the Social Vulnerability Index (66.2% vs. 58.6%). For spatial downscaling in data-scarce settings, PPE integrates localized proxies to double baseline accuracy in Nigerian food security indicators ($R^2$ of 66.1% vs. 31.5%). For epidemiological nowcasting of the 2026 DRC Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, PPE achieves a Recall@10 of 83.3% (identifying 15 of 18 newly invaded health zones across five weekly forecasts), a +10.3 percentage-point improvement over the public state-of-the-art modeling (~73%). By combining autonomous multimodal planetary data discovery with targeted model optimization, PPE lowers the technical barrier to planetary-scale analytics, enabling rapid, customized, expert-level deployment.
articles.bodyZh:
从粮食安全到灾害风险，从疾病暴发到社会经济脆弱性——应对这些全球性重大挑战，离不开高精度的地理空间建模。不过，想要搭建出能预测全球变化的模型，眼下最大的瓶颈是数据生态太碎片化。过去你得手动下载数据、整理多模态数据、做融合，还要反复试错地挑模型，整套流程又慢又繁琐。

我们这次带来的是"行星预测引擎"（Planetary Prediction Engine，PPE），一个全自动的AI系统。你只需要用自然语言提问，它就能把上面这套端到端的流程从头到尾跑完。PPE会即时整合多模态数据：一边从开放网页和地球观测平台（比如Data Commons、Google Earth Engine）上抓取与时空相关的协变量，一边把它们与地理空间基础模型（如PDFM、AlphaEarth）的嵌入特征融合在一起。同时，它还会自动搜索适合当前任务的模型架构，并内置防过拟合机制把关。

在多种任务、不同地区和多个科学领域中，PPE的表现都稳定超过了现有最强模型以及专家手动调优的基线。以美国空间回归任务为例，PPE在21项CDC（美国疾控中心）健康指标上的平均R²从基线的60.0%提升到了76.8%；FEMA（美国联邦应急管理署）全国风险指数从60.0%提升到64.9%；社会脆弱性指数（Social Vulnerability Index）也从58.6%提升到了66.2%。

在数据稀缺场景下做空间降尺度（spatial downscaling）时，PPE通过整合本地替代数据，把尼日利亚粮食安全指标的R²做到了66.1%，而基线只有31.5%——相当于把精度直接翻了一倍。

在2026年刚果民主共和国本迪布焦型埃博拉疫情的流行病即时预测中，PPE的召回率@10（Recall@10）达到83.3%——在五轮每周预测中，18个新被入侵的卫生区它成功识别出了15个；相比目前公开最优模型约73%的表现，提升了10.3个百分点。

PPE把自主的多模态行星数据发现与针对性的模型优化结合在了一起，大大降低了全球尺度数据分析的技术门槛，让快速、定制化、专家级的部署成为可能。

articles.title: TraceML: An Empirical Analysis of Human-Agent Planning in Machine Learning Development
articles.zh: TraceML: An Empirical Analysis of Human-Agent Planning in Machine Learning Development
articles.author: Jiarui Yan, Weiwei Sun 等
articles.body: Large language models write correct code for isolated problems but remain far weaker at autonomous machine-learning development, where an agent must revise data pipelines, models, and validation over hours of feedback, and on most competitions still finishes below strong human competitors. Outcome-based benchmarks record this gap but not its cause, because they grade the final submission and discard the development process behind it. We introduce TraceML, which pairs human and agent work on the same competitions under one version-level schema: 4,465 human Kaggle trajectories across 134 competitions, seven of which are also worked by two agent scaffolds, giving 430 paired human and 207 agent trajectories. Every code version carries its score, its timestamp, and labels for the action taken, its intent, the edit size, and the score effect. Read this way, the gap becomes concrete. Experts alternate data work, validation, model changes, and ensembling, and return to approaches they had set aside. Each agent scaffold instead collapses into a narrow loop: Codex spends its steps re-weighting ensembles and tuning submissions, MLEvolve mutates its model in place, and neither pivots at the human rate nor reopens abandoned work. A short planning prompt distilled from human practice moves the behaviors it names toward the human profile and lifts scores, but the effort profile stays agent-shaped: instruction closes only the part of the gap that reduces to instructions. We release the corpus, the schema, the labelers, and the extraction pipeline at https://huggingface.co/datasets/jerryyan/TraceML.
articles.bodyZh: 大型语言模型写单个独立问题的代码时挺靠谱，但一放到自动化机器学习开发上就露馅了。这种场景下，智能体得在好几个小时的反馈循环里不断调整数据管道、模型和验证方法，而大多数比赛里，它们还是比不过人类顶尖选手。基于结果的基准测试能看出这个差距，却说不清到底为什么——因为它们只给最终提交打分，把背后整个开发过程直接扔掉了。我们搞了个新数据集叫TraceML，把人类和智能体放在同一批比赛、同一个版本管理框架下干活：一共采集了134场Kaggle比赛里4465条人类操作轨迹，其中7场比赛也让两种智能体框架各跑了一遍，最终得到430条人类轨迹和207条智能体轨迹做配对。每个代码版本都带上了得分、时间戳，还标注了这一步做了什么操作、意图是什么、改动多大、对分数有什么影响。从这个角度看，差距就变得很具体了。人类选手会在数据清洗、验证、改模型、调集成之间来回切换，还会回头捡起之前放下的路子。而每个智能体框架都只会钻进一条窄胡同里打转：Codex把时间全花在给集成重新加权和调提交上，MLEvolve就死磕同一个模型不停地变异，俩都不会像人那样频繁换方向，也不会重新捡起丢掉的方案。我们把人类经验提炼成一段简短的规划提示词，喂给智能体之后，它被提到的那些行为确实更接近人类了，分数也涨了，但整体的操作节奏还是那副智能体模样——靠指令能补上的那部分差距，就只是指令能补上的那一部分而已。我们把整个数据集、版本结构、标注工具和提取流程都放出来了，地址是https://huggingface.co/datasets/jerryyan/TraceML。

articles.title: ICON Decomposition: Multivariate Concept-Level Explanations of Deep Representations for Model Auditing
articles.zh: ICON Decomposition: Multivariate Concept-Level Explanations of Deep Representations for Model Auditing
articles.author: Roshan Prakash Rane, Marco Simnacher 等
articles.body: Deep neural networks often exploit spurious associations in their training data, a failure known as shortcut learning. Concept-based explainability methods screen for shortcuts by testing whether concepts such as a patient's sex or scanner settings can be decoded from a network layer. Because each concept is evaluated in isolation, these methods can mistake correlations between concepts as evidence that the model uses them. We introduce ICON decomposition, which instead quantifies how much of a layer's variance each concept explains after accounting for all other concepts and the outcome. On synthetic data with known ground truth, ICON recovers concept importance more accurately than seven alternative baseline methods. On skin-lesion and brain-imaging models, it isolates the concepts on which a model genuinely relies, quantifies the representation unexplained by any of the supplied concepts, and yields sparse explanations that we validate by retraining and out-of-distribution testing.
articles.bodyZh: 深度神经网络经常会在训练数据里“捡到”一些虚假的相关性——明明只是碰巧有关，模型却当真了，这种翻车现象叫做“走捷径学习”（shortcut learning）。为了揪出这类问题，基于概念的可解释性方法（concept-based explainability methods）会去测试一个网络的某一层能不能“解码”出某个概念，比如患者的性别、扫描设备的参数等等。但问题在于，这些方法是一个概念一个概念单独测的，很容易把概念之间的相关性错当成模型真的在用它。我们提出的ICON分解方法就能解决这个痛点：它在考虑所有其他概念和最终结果之后，再算出每个概念究竟解释了这一层多少方差（variance）。在已知真实答案的合成数据上，ICON比七种基线方法都更准确地还原了概念的重要性。用在皮肤病变和脑影像模型上时，它能精准分离出模型真正依赖的概念，量化出未被任何已给概念解释掉的那部分表征，并给出稀疏的解释——我们还通过重新训练和分布外测试（out-of-distribution testing）验证了这些解释的可靠性。
